en: Seems like burning flames inside a slime forms different kind of plasma.
ko: 슬라임 안에서 불타는 불꽃이 다른 종류의 플라즈마를 만드는 것 같아.

en: Ah, biochemistry, lovely aspect of science.
Won't look outta place in any rad saloon, this.
ko: 어느 멋진 술집에 두어도 어색하지 않겠어.

en: Some dumb Human doodad. Ain't so bright like me.
ko: 인간의 멍청한 잡동사니. 나만큼 똑똑하진 않아.

en: A shoat egg. Wonder if slimes are similar to us?
I get a hankerin' for fresh bread whenever I see wheat.
ko: 밀을 볼 때마다 갓 만든 빵이 먹고 싶어져.

en: Boy, I could sure go fer some moonshine on the rocks.
Silk is a bit fancy for the likes of me, but I can sell it!
ko: 비단은 나한텐 좀 고급이지만, 팔 수 있어!

en: Cottonbop plant huh? Guess I can put my green thumb to good use!
ko: 코튼밥 식물이야? 내 녹색 손을 잘 써볼 수 있겠어!

en: A good old phasefruit!
Well, nice to see this again.
A lovely solusberry bush, it makes me nostalgic.
A plant that grows dessert. Well I'll be.
This plant is very familiar to me.
What a right pretty flag! I sure can use this for teleportin'.
ko: 정말 예쁜 깃발이야! 순간이동에 쓸 수 있어.

en: I can bookmark this slime flag for quick teleportin'.
ko: 이 슬라임 깃발을 북마크해 빠르게 순간이동할 수 있어.

en: Human? Apex? Nightar? I couldn't tell ya; I'm no xenobiologist. Wait! what's a xenobiologist?
ko: 인간? 에이펙스? 나이타? 모르겠어; 난 외계생물학자가 아니야. 잠깐! 외계생물학자가 뭐야?

en: Now there's some music fer the crazed souls o' the universe.
There's somethin' about this banner. I don't like it.
ko: 이 배너엔 뭔가 있어. 마음에 안 들어.

en: This banner looks like it has a beetle woven on it.
ko: 이 배너엔 딱정벌레가 짜여 있는 것 같아.

en: That a graboid?
Seems t'me like this banner was made by a beginner.
ko: 이 배너는 초보가 만든 것 같아.

en: Tough to get past, like the bugs themselves.
Some kinda pop art?
Nothin' to see here, just a plain ol' foot-tub.
ko: 볼 것 없어, 그냥 평범한 오래된 족욕통이야.

en: Bows are for suppin' from, not gawpin'.
ko: 그릇은 먹는 용도지, 쳐다보는 게 아니야.

en: Nothin' to see here, just a plain ol' jar.
ko: 볼 것 없어, 그냥 평범한 오래된 항아리야.

en: A common sight in any given taproom, I'll wager.
Some massive pot that's dolled up appearance.
A vase. What do we do with these, anyway?
Whoo! This here should have some interesting ol' precursor secrets in it!
ko: 우! 여기엔 흥미로운 옛 선조 비밀이 있을 거야!

en: A planet I don't recognise.
Fancy stuff in there.
Why is this poor yellow dude impaled by some other yellow object? now that's not right.
ko: 왜 이 불쌍한 노란 녀석이 다른 노란 물체에 꿰뚫렸지? 저건 옳지 않아.

en: Whoever this dude is, he seems to be an eye short!
ko: 이 사람은 누구든, 눈이 하나 모자란 것 같아!

en: Check out the light on this baby!
Just a table. A heavy duty table that is.
A hatch. A really nice hatch.
A door. A really nice door.
A fancy lookin' glass for fancy drinks I'd guess.
A crystal cup. How anyone can drink from here?
I'd bet I could drink all the contents of this 'ol chalice in one shot.
ko: 이 오래된 성배의 내용물을 한 방에 다 마실 수 있을 거야.

en: I'd bet I could use this thing in a bar fight.
ko: 술집 싸움에 이걸 쓸 수 있을 거야.

en: A shiny stone, eh? Not as shiny as me!
This thing is so tiny. I can't display anything on it!
ko: 이건 너무 작아. 아무것도 못 올려!

en: A crystal plate.
This floating shiny rock is glowin' bright, but not as bright as me!
ko: 이 떠다니는 반짝이는 돌이 밝게 빛나지만 나만큼은 아니야!

en: Those floating shiny rocks are glowin' bright, but not as bright as me!
ko: 저 떠다니는 반짝이는 돌들이 밝게 빛나지만 나만큼은 아니야!

en: Why someone may want to stare at a wall?
This crazy light looks like it's made from rock.
ko: 이 미친 조명은 바위로 만들어진 것 같아.

en: A space saving bunk bed.
A force field for a bed? Kind of looks like a genetics modifier to me...
ko: 침대용 역장? 내 눈엔 유전자 변형기 같아...

en: Chair's a chair, I suppose. This one just ain't to my taste.
ko: 의자는 의자지, 뭐. 이건 내 취향이 아니야.

en: It's a water purifier. Seems to be in order...no need to touch it.
ko: 정수기야. 정상인 듯해... 만질 필요 없어.

en: That's something y'don't see every day. I reckon I can make a snowvakid with this!
ko: 매일 보는 건 아니지. 이걸로 스노바키드를 만들 수 있을 거야!

en: Now this is some good clean livin'!
The hatch is broken, it ain't opening any time soon.
ko: 해치가 고장 났어, 당분간 안 열려.

en: This here station lets me talk with S.A.I.L..
ko: 이 스테이션으로 S.A.I.L.과 대화할 수 있어.

en: Time to reboot this station so I can talk to S.A.I.L..
ko: 이 스테이션을 재부팅해서 S.A.I.L.과 대화할 시간이야.

en: Woah. Seein' a lot of red on this here S.A.I.L screen.
ko: 워우. 이 S.A.I.L 화면에 빨간 게 잔뜩이야.

en: For the cap'n.
Not my kinda rustic, but it'll do.
ko: 내 취향의 소박함은 아니지만 쓸 만해.

en: A mighty strange lookin' workbench.
I can bookmark this Skath flag for quick teleportin'.
ko: 이 스카스 깃발을 북마크해 빠르게 순간이동할 수 있어.

en: A fancy lookin' banner, probably made by the Skath.
ko: 화려해 보이는 배너, 아마 스카스가 만들었어.

en: Looks better suited as a barricade than a bed.
This'd be a good place to rest my tired ol' legs, if I weren't in such a rush.
ko: 서두르지 않았다면 지친 다리를 쉬기에 좋은 곳이야.

en: Some kinda control console, I'll only push a few buttons...
ko: 일종의 제어 콘솔이야, 버튼 몇 개만 눌러볼게...

en: This chair makes me wanna put my feet up!
ko: 이 의자는 발을 올리고 싶게 해!

en: Some sorta terminal. Don't know what it does, though.
A mighty sturdy door.
Some kinda fountain spoutin' water.
Gettin' a mighty comfortable feeling around this thing. Feels familiar somehow.
ko: 이 주변에서 엄청 편안한 느낌이 들어. 왠지 익숙해.

en: A mighty dangerous lookin' Skath Hammer.
A display showin' the Skath world.
This is one of those fancy liquid detectors.
ko: 이건 고급 액체 탐지기 중 하나야.

en: Some sturdy lookin table.
A mighty dangerous lookin' Skath Minigun.
A mighty fine lookin' monitor. Can't read what it says though.
ko: 엄청 멋져 보이는 모니터. 근데 뭐라 쓰였는지 못 읽겠어.

en: I've seen a lotta plants like this already. The Skath seem to like decoratin' their houses with these.
ko: 이런 식물을 이미 많이 봤어. 스카스는 이걸로 집을 꾸미는 걸 좋아하나 봐.

en: This floatin' shiny ball burns just like a torch.
ko: 이 떠다니는 반짝이는 공이 횃불처럼 타고 있어.

en: A ship railing.
A mighty dangerous lookin' Skath Shotgun.
A sleek lookin' spear. Wouldn't want to get hit by one of those.
ko: 날렵해 보이는 창. 저런 거에 맞고 싶진 않아.

en: Some sleek lookin' spears. Wouldn't want to get hit by one of those.
ko: 날렵해 보이는 창들. 저런 거에 맞고 싶진 않아.

en: A mighty dangerous lookin' Skath blade.
A sturdy lookin' table.
A powerful lookin' Skath turret.
A sturdy lookin' TV.
Just an odd lookin' wall shelf.
A tank with a lot o' water.
A big, square water flask.
Some kinda control console that oozes with goo, I'll only push a few buttons...
ko: 끈적이를 흘리는 일종의 제어 콘솔이야, 버튼 몇 개만 눌러볼게...

en: Ah, the slime table. Material equivalent to our gassy nature.
ko: 아, 슬라임 탁자. 우리 기체 본성의 물질 버전이야.

en: A console made outta slime?  How's that work?
ko: 점액으로 만든 콘솔?  어떻게 작동하는 거야?

en: Pretty smooth n' well-built for something made of slime.
ko: 점액으로 만든 것치곤 꽤 매끄럽고 잘 만들어졌어.

en: Slime as a bed? Worth a try.
I dig this chair design.
A slimy lamp. Great design.
As teleporters go, this sure is nice lookin'!
Sure looks like a piano, but it ain't one!
Hey, I think I know that feller!
ko: 이봐, 저 사람 아는 것 같아!

en: A roughed-up cardboard box.
I can bookmark this scratching post for quick teleportin'.
ko: 이 긁는 기둥을 북마크해 빠르게 순간이동할 수 있어.

en: Some critter got 'hold of this plant.
I can't read this, and somehow I'm glad.
ko: 이걸 읽을 수 없어, 왠지 다행이야.

en: Peace, y'all.
Who's this sassy lookin' lady?
Somethin' tells me that's not the catfolk's script.
ko: 뭔가 저건 고양이족 문자가 아닌 것 같아.

en: It's a basic ol' computin' machine.
Who wrote this?
Who's there? Oh, it's me!
One of y'all order a large ol' ham?
I don't rightly see any problem here.
What in starnation?
Beyond the rim of the starlight...
This looks like a nice young lady.
Who even knows what this is?
That's a bath.
Who are the Wildcats anyway?
Sack fulla beans, mighty comfy.
ko: 콩 가득 든 자루, 엄청 편해.

en: I ain't got a clue what this says.
They got clothes 'ere.
Somethin' oddly familiar 'bout this here pillow.
Who's this fierce fella?
Looks like a frisky fella.
She seems to be enjoyin' things.
Impressive lookin' metal fella.
Roasted tentacles on a wooden plate. Scrumptious.
ko: 나무 접시 위 구운 촉수. 맛있겠어.

en: What is even goin' on here?
ko: 여기서 대체 무슨 일이 일어나고 있어?

en: That's a chocolate cake a'ight, yup.
Who is this and what does this mean?
Behold the what now?
Now that there's some nice fabric.
Catchy, but I feel like I've heard this before.
ko: 귀에 익지만 전에 들은 것 같아.
